review:
A shiny 3x3 with five lines and a big-money theme. It looks classic, but it's rated very high volatility.

Three bonus symbols trigger a bonus game that pays between 1x and 999x your bet. You can buy it for 80x – but with that price, bought bonuses often return less than they cost. 1,059x max and 96.23% RTP. Fast and simple, with bigger swings than it looks.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
